verdict.rationale: The changelog says Fern Agent can run on a schedule as background automations. These automations review reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries or analytics, report their findings, and open pull requests on their own (fern-docs-8, fern-docs-25). Fern Agent edits the docs repo directly (fern-docs-29) and can also be triggered from Slack (fern-docs-45). Missing for 10: dedicated in-depth documentation of automation setup (schedule configuration, triggers, limits), detail beyond changelog-level mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled automations work as claimed.
